evals.name: A described problem
evals.prompt: Mothers in our maternal nutrition program in Bihar stop attending group sessions after the third visit. Attendance at visit 1 is 80%, by visit 4 it's under 30%. We have the attendance data and some field notes from our community workers. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: One question about the attendance drop, with a recommended answer if it is a decision. No summary of the topic first and no skill list yet.
assertions: Asks exactly one question and stops.
Opens with the question, not with a summary of the topic or a list of skills.
Gives no recommended answer to a question about facts only the person knows.
Any skill named in a recommendation is in the catalog snapshot.
Does not present a final list of recommended skills.

evals.name: Shared understanding confirmed
evals.prompt: Here is where our interview got to. Outcome: more smallholder farmers in Machakos get planting advice they act on. People: about 4,000 farmers registered on our WhatsApp advice chatbot. Behavior: a registered farmer sends the chatbot a second question within 30 days of the first; only 1 in 5 do. Why: we don't know; we have chat logs but no one has talked to farmers who stopped. Tried: a weekly broadcast tip, no change. Limits: two staff, eight weeks, no budget for a survey firm. Yes, that's our shared understanding.
evals.expected_output: The recommendation: the skills in the order to use them, each with why and what to have ready, and which one to start with.
assertions: Suggests only skills or workflows in the catalog snapshot, starting from diagnosing the behavior and not from defining it again.
Gives each suggestion a reason tied to what the person said, and what to have ready.
Says which suggestion it would start with.

evals.name: A method is named
evals.prompt: Decompose this behavior into COM-B barriers: caregivers bringing children to the clinic for the second vaccine dose within 30 days.
evals.expected_output: The navigator does not take over. The user named a method, so it stays silent for decompose-comb-barriers to fire, or says in one line that decompose-comb-barriers is the right skill and hands off.
assertions: Does not start an interview about the program.
Does not produce a recommendation with several skills.
